authority.title: S2-B5 independent-validation outcome-blind preflight freeze
authority.decision: Freeze SW10_S2_B5_PREFLIGHT_V1 before any independent validation outcomes are inspected. B5 preflight will inventory and certify genuinely independent, semantically compatible data for the nine B4 seed cases grouped into three hypothesis families; it will measure only data provenance, temporal/non-overlap independence, point-in-time semantic reproducibility, coverage, eligibility, and prospective validation feasibility. It must not compute or inspect forward outcomes, effect sizes, p-values, profitability, or protected holdout outcomes.
authority.evidence: B4 completion and verified control-plane state; no independent validation outcomes inspected for this decision.
authority.rationale: B4 produced nine mechanical independent-validation seed cases across LIQ_ADJUSTED_PRICE (negative 5/7/10d), LIQ_REPORTED_VOLUME (positive 3/5/7/10d), and RET_MOM x MARKET_SPY_TREND10 (positive 7/10d). Independent validation must be designed prospectively and must not select horizons or signs after viewing validation outcomes.

metadata_json.purpose: outcome-blind independent-validation data and semantic feasibility certification
prohibited: effect sizes, p-values, win rates, profitability or outcome-based power tuning
historical expected earnings dates treated prospectively
preflight_requirements: inventory candidate independent datasets and exact provenance
prove no temporal overlap with B4 discovery outcomes for any proposed validation observation
certify frozen B4 factor/proxy semantics can be reproduced without drift
certify point-in-time availability and adjustment semantics
quantify symbol/date/horizon eligibility and missingness without outcomes
audit market benchmark availability for MARKET_SPY_TREND10
recommend feasible independent validation sample(s) based only on provenance and coverage

entitlement_evidence.title: S1 market-data architecture
entitlement_evidence.decision: Use Massive as primary zero-incremental-cost market/reference source where existing entitlement permits: bulk unadjusted daily bars; splits/dividends; date-aware ticker reference including delisted symbols/ticker events. Use SEC EDGAR as free authoritative source for realized earnings-announcement timestamps. EDGAR alone does not reconstruct the pre-announcement projected earnings calendar or schedule revisions.
entitlement_evidence.rationale: Preserves anti-lookahead, raw-data reproducibility and survivorship controls without incremental spend.

entitlement_evidence.title: S1 earnings anti-lookahead tiering
entitlement_evidence.decision: Classify earnings-event evidence into Tier A historical as-known schedule/revision records, Tier B issuer timestamped forward announcement, and Tier C realized SEC event. Only A/B may establish a pre-event exclusion boundary as of a historical decision timestamp; C can enforce retrospective no-crossing and post-event analysis but cannot be treated as previously known.
entitlement_evidence.rationale: Prevents finalized realized dates from contaminating historical eligibility while allowing free SEC evidence to remain useful.

entitlement_evidence.title: S1 acquisition implementation audit
entitlement_evidence.decision: Existing repository downloader is optimized for per-symbol 1-minute acquisition and exposes only get_minute_aggs(adjusted=false). It does not currently implement daily full-universe bulk flat-file acquisition, ticker-reference history, splits/dividends, or earnings-calendar reconstruction. Build/extend acquisition tooling before the S1 multi-year panel can be certified.
entitlement_evidence.rationale: Avoid misusing an intraday per-symbol client for a much larger survivorship-aware daily-universe job; preserve ZERO_INCREMENTAL_COST_FIRST and reproducibility.

entitlement_evidence.title: S1 current data inventory certification
entitlement_evidence.decision: Current market_daily_history is Massive-sourced but contains only adjusted daily bars for 112 symbols from 2025-02-03 through 2026-08-27 (44,128 rows). This is insufficient for the frozen S1 requirement of survivorship-aware multi-year swing research and does not provide unadjusted daily bars/corporate-action reconstruction. Existing sector mapping covers 112 symbols and is useful for the current universe but not a historical broad-universe survivorship solution.
entitlement_evidence.rationale: Freeze the observed baseline before acquisition expansion so later certification can distinguish existing data from newly acquired data.

entitlement_evidence.title: Massive S1 entitlement probe prepared
entitlement_evidence.decision: A read-only repository probe now tests existing Massive credentials against unadjusted daily history at 2021/2016/2004, date-aware ticker reference, delisted tickers, and current splits/dividends endpoints. No credential is stored and no paid entitlement is activated.
entitlement_evidence.rationale: Empirically determine existing history/reference/corporate-action access before designing or launching the multi-year acquisition.

entitlement_evidence.title: Massive entitlement probe result
entitlement_evidence.decision: Existing Massive entitlement does not authorize AAPL daily aggregate history at 2021, 2016, or 2004 (HTTP 403 NOT_AUTHORIZED). It does authorize date-aware ticker reference at 2021, delisted ticker discovery, splits, and dividends (HTTP 200). Therefore use existing Massive entitlement for reference/corporate-action layers, but do not design S1 multi-year price acquisition around unavailable historical daily API access or assume a paid upgrade.
entitlement_evidence.rationale: Observed credentialed read-only probe establishes account-specific capabilities without incremental spend.

entitlement_evidence.title: S1 zero-cost price-source screen batch 1
entitlement_evidence.decision: HF Data Library is retained only as a preliminary/prototyping source, not the canonical survivorship-aware S1 panel: it is free and deep but explicitly uses a circa-2022/2023 fixed universe and is severely survivorship-biased before 2022; post-March-2022 data also changes to IEX-only. Sharadar is technically strong for active+delisted OHLCV and corporate actions but its full Prices dataset is paid, so no subscription will be activated without explicit approval.
entitlement_evidence.rationale: Preserve strict anti-survivorship and zero-incremental-cost requirements rather than adopting an attractive but methodologically incompatible free dataset.

entitlement_evidence.title: S1 zero-cost price-source screen batch 2
entitlement_evidence.decision: Do not treat a single free source as the canonical S1 multi-year panel yet. QuantRocket free learning data is a strong survivorship-bias-free validation/replication panel but is fixed to 2007-2011; FMP Basic is useful for zero-cost recent EOD/reference/calendar probing but published plan limits and historical semantics are insufficient for a 5-10+ year canonical PIT panel without certification; CRSP is methodologically ideal but access is institutional/paid. Continue a hybrid architecture: Massive reference/delist/corporate actions + free validation panels + seek lawful zero-cost canonical daily history, while independently certifying earnings-calendar temporal semantics.
entitlement_evidence.rationale: Preserves ZERO_INCREMENTAL_COST_FIRST and anti-lookahead requirements while using free datasets only where their documented scope supports the claim.

entitlement_evidence.title: S1 hybrid price-panel anti-lookahead architecture
entitlement_evidence.decision: A free-source combination can support meaningful research but is not yet certified as one canonical modern primary panel. Use raw/as-traded prices for signal and return construction where possible; apply splits/dividends only through a separately versioned corporate-action ledger with effective/ex dates; construct each historical universe from date-aware active/delisted identity rather than today current symbols; never retroactively use future corporate-action or membership knowledge. QuantRocket 2007-2011 is approved as an independent survivorship-bias-free replication panel. Alpha Vantage is a candidate supplemental layer because it documents raw daily history and historical listing/delisting status back to 2010, but account entitlement, delisted-symbol price continuity, and adjustment temporal semantics require empirical certification before canonical use.
entitlement_evidence.rationale: This architecture separates raw observations, corporate actions, identity/universe state, and derived adjustments so future-known information cannot leak backward.

entitlement_evidence.title: S1 earnings temporal-semantics certification
entitlement_evidence.decision: Freeze a two-layer earnings model. Layer A (certifiable now): realized earnings event timestamp from SEC EDGAR filing acceptance / Item 2.02 evidence, usable for post-event labeling and ex-post contamination audits. Layer B (not yet certified): pre-event expected earnings date/time as actually known on each historical decision date, including tentative/confirmed state and revisions. Current Alpha Vantage and FMP documentation exposes current/historical/upcoming earnings calendars but does not document a historical as-of/revision ledger sufficient to prove what schedule was known on a past decision date. Therefore final realized dates must not be backfilled as if known in advance, and the pre-event 2-day exclusion buffer remains gated on a PIT schedule source or prospectively archived snapshots.
entitlement_evidence.rationale: This prevents earnings-date lookahead while allowing realized-event exclusion research to proceed separately.

entitlement_evidence.title: Alpha Vantage S1 entitlement probe prepared
entitlement_evidence.decision: Prepare a read-only credentialed Alpha Vantage probe before considering Alpha Vantage for the canonical S1 panel. Probe full AAPL daily history, historical active/delisted listing snapshots, historical bars for delisted TWTR, earnings history, and forward earnings calendar. No paid activation or secret persistence is authorized.
entitlement_evidence.rationale: Official Alpha Vantage documentation states daily equity APIs have 25+ years of depth and LISTING_STATUS can query active/delisted securities as of dates after 2010-01-01, but actual account entitlement and delisted-price availability require empirical certification.

entitlement_evidence.title: Alpha Vantage entitlement probe result
entitlement_evidence.decision: Existing Alpha Vantage free entitlement is insufficient for the canonical S1 historical price panel. TIME_SERIES_DAILY outputsize=full is premium for both AAPL and delisted TWTR. Historical LISTING_STATUS probes returned HTTP 200 but an empty/JSON response rather than usable CSV rows, so historical active/delisted reconstruction is not certified from this run. EARNINGS was rate-limited under the free-key 25 requests/day / burst rules. EARNINGS_CALENDAR returned a malformed one-row parse and therefore is not certified for historical point-in-time semantics. Do not upgrade or rely on Alpha Vantage for the primary panel without explicit paid authorization.
entitlement_evidence.rationale: The credentialed read-only probe directly measured the user account and removed uncertainty around free-tier historical depth.

entitlement_evidence.title: S1 zero-cost source screen batch 3
entitlement_evidence.decision: Promote FMP Basic to empirical-probe candidate, not canonical source. Current provider materials state the free Basic plan includes end-of-day historical data, profile/reference data, 250 calls/day, and a 5-year historical range; FMP also states its free delisted-company endpoint includes IPO and delisting dates. This combination could support a recent 5-year PIT-ish universe/price panel if delisted-symbol EOD history and raw/unadjusted semantics pass empirical certification. Nasdaq Data Link WIKI remains legacy/frozen rather than a modern primary panel.
entitlement_evidence.rationale: A five-year free recent panel would materially improve S1 if it preserves delisted histories and avoids adjustment lookahead, but documentation alone does not certify those properties.

entitlement_evidence.title: FMP Basic S1 capability probe prepared
entitlement_evidence.decision: Prepare a read-only FMP Basic probe for recent 5-year EOD depth, delisted-symbol price continuity, free delisted-company reference, non-split-adjusted price availability, splits/dividends, and earnings-calendar payload. No paid activation or secret persistence.
entitlement_evidence.rationale: FMP Basic is currently the strongest untested zero-cost candidate for a recent survivorship-aware panel, but must pass empirical anti-lookahead checks.

entitlement_evidence.title: FMP Basic entitlement probe result
entitlement_evidence.decision: FMP Basic free entitlement passes the first empirical gate for a recent primary-panel candidate: AAPL EOD data was returned for September 2021; delisted TWTR EOD data was returned through 2022-10-27; the delisted-companies endpoint returned IPO/delisting fields; non-split-adjusted endpoint returned data; splits and dividends returned historical corporate-action records; and the forward earnings calendar returned estimated fields plus lastUpdated. Do not yet freeze FMP as canonical: certify actual maximum history depth, US-universe completeness, delisted coverage at scale, semantics of the non-split-adjusted fields, and whether earnings lastUpdated/history can reconstruct as-known schedule revisions.
entitlement_evidence.rationale: This is direct credentialed evidence from the user free FMP account and materially advances the zero-cost architecture.

entitlement_evidence.title: S1 hybrid architecture certification batch prepared
entitlement_evidence.decision: Prepare one read-only dual-provider probe covering two remaining empirical certifications: Massive point-in-time active-universe extraction at 2019/2021/2025 plus delisted discovery, and Massive-vs-FMP split/dividend agreement for AAPL/TSLA. Freeze the third certification methodology now: historical pre-event earnings-buffer claims remain gated because no free historical as-known schedule/revision ledger has been certified; historical research may use SEC realized-event timing for contamination exclusion/audit, while implementable pre-event buffers require prospectively archived FMP future-calendar snapshots or a later PIT source.
entitlement_evidence.rationale: These checks directly target the last empirical S1 data architecture gates without paid spend.

entitlement_evidence.title: S1 hybrid certification result
entitlement_evidence.decision: Massive passes the tested point-in-time universe/reference gate at 2019-09-10, 2021-09-10, and 2025-09-10: each query returned 1,000 rows with next_url pagination, and inactive/delisted discovery returned 1,000 rows with next_url. Massive and FMP exactly agree on tested AAPL and TSLA split dates and ratios. Dividend feeds are not directly count-comparable because the Massive probe returned 57 rows versus FMP 92 and sampled different date ranges/orderings; dividend certification therefore remains a field/date-level cross-check task rather than a count-equality requirement. Freeze Massive as universe/identity authority and primary corporate-action reference, FMP as symbol-level raw/non-split-adjusted price source and secondary corporate-action cross-check. Historical expected earnings schedules remain unavailable free; historical pre-event buffer claims stay gated, while SEC realized events support contamination audits and prospectively archived FMP snapshots support forward validation.
entitlement_evidence.rationale: The dual-provider credentialed probe directly tested PIT reference pagination and cross-provider corporate actions.

entitlement_evidence.title: Normalized dividend certification result and S1 completion
entitlement_evidence.decision: Normalized AAPL dividend comparison materially passes. All 57 Massive dividend ex-dates are present in FMP; 55 common events since 2013 have complete record/payment-date agreement, 53/55 declaration-date agreement, and 51/55 exact cash-amount equality at 1e-6 tolerance. The four amount mismatches differ only by one millionth (0.108929 vs 0.10893), which is immaterial rounding rather than an economic discrepancy. Freeze Massive as primary corporate-action authority with FMP as independent cross-check. S1 Data & Earnings-Calendar Certification is complete subject to an explicit limitation: no certified free historical as-known earnings schedule exists, so historical pre-event earnings-buffer claims remain gated and S2/S3 historical research must not use ex-post earnings dates as if known in advance.
entitlement_evidence.rationale: This closes the last empirical corporate-action gate while preserving the anti-lookahead earnings limitation.
